repo: The repo uses markdownlint with a .markdownlintignore file; GSD-related directories must be explicitly excluded.

code.finding: Added .claude/gsd-local-patches/ to the ignore list to prevent markdownlint failures on GSD patch files.

GSD updates touch ~159 files and require checking for new patch directories that may not be covered by existing lint ignores.

friction: Markdownlint pre-commit hook failed on .claude/gsd-local-patches/ because that directory was missing from .markdownlintignore, requiring an extra commit to fix before the update could land.
